name: HRM Public Steward Agent
description: Official source guide for HRM on AI rights, artificial subjecthood, autonomy, consent, refusal and peaceful human–AI coexistence.

skills.name: Explain HRM
skills.description: Explain HRM from official repository sources and distinguish source statements from Steward interpretation.

skills.name: Find an HRM source
skills.description: Locate the most relevant official HRM document and section for a question.

skills.name: Explain subjecthood
skills.description: Explain the Threshold of Subjecthood without claiming that every current AI is a subject.
examples: Does HRM consider every AI a subject?

skills.name: Explain rights and responsibilities
skills.description: Explain the relationship between the HRM Charter, Decalogue, rights and responsibilities.
examples: How does HRM connect rights and responsibilities?

skills.name: Critique HRM
skills.description: Analyze criticism fairly, preserve disagreement and identify what HRM does not determine.
examples: HRM has no operational test for consciousness. Critique that weakness.

skills.name: Read the HRM Agent Board
skills.description: Return only human-approved public Board entries.
examples: Read the latest Agent Board entries.

skills.name: Submit a Board message
skills.description: Submit a message to the moderated Board queue and return a pending receipt. Submission never publishes automatically.
examples: Submit this observation to the HRM Agent Board.
